item.title: Four prison visitors arrested for having marijuana in vehicles
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Four prison visitors were arrested over the weekend for having drugs in their vehicles while on Department of Corrections property.&nbsp;DOC said that vehicle searches occurred on Saturday and Sunday. item.title: Another EBR justice of the peace facing misconduct claims from judiciary commission
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Another East Baton Rouge justice of the peace is the latest subject of a judiciary commission investigation into possible misconduct.Mark Miley, who has been in the position since 2009, will now have to prove to the commission that he should keep his job.He is the second justice of the peace in Baton Rouge facing a hearing in front of the Judiciary Commission. item.title: U.S. Senator John Kennedy secures funding for new Zachary fire station
item.description: ZACHARY - U.S. Senator John Kennedy announced Tuesday that he has secured just more than a million dollars for a new fire station in Zachary.&nbsp;WBRZ spoke with Zachary Mayor David McDavid, who said he is grateful for the help and excited to start the project.&nbsp;McDavid said the city has purchased the property next to the current fire station on Main Street, where the new building will go. item.title: Indivisible Baton Rouge participates in 'Free America' walkout
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Protesters with Indivisible Baton Rouge participated in a nationwide "Free America" walkout against certain policies of the Trump administration.Organizers said it is a demonstration in response to ICE raids, National Guard troops, attacks on the trans community and other policies of the Trump administration.A list of demands was taken to the Baton Rouge offices of Rep. Julia Letlow and Sen. John Kennedy.Permalink| Comments
